webSearch.apiKey.label: Bright Data API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Bright Data API key for search/scraping/browser/web-data (fallback env vars: BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY, then BRIGHTDATA_API_TOKEN).

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Bright Data API Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Bright Data API base URL override.

webSearch.serpZone.label: Bright Data SERP Zone
webSearch.serpZone.help: Bright Data SERP zone name for search tools (required for brightdata_search and brightdata_search_batch).

webSearch.customerId.label: Bright Data Customer ID
webSearch.customerId.help: Bright Data customer ID for async SERP endpoints (fallback env var: BRIGHTDATA_CUSTOMER_ID).

webSearch.yandexApiKey.label: Bright Data Yandex SERP API Key
webSearch.yandexApiKey.help: Optional Bright Data API key override for Yandex SERP requests (fallback env var: BRIGHTDATA_YANDEX_SERP_API_TOKEN).

webSearch.yandexCustomerId.label: Bright Data Yandex Customer ID
webSearch.yandexCustomerId.help: Optional Bright Data customer ID override for Yandex async SERP requests (fallback env var: BRIGHTDATA_YANDEX_CUSTOMER_ID).

webSearch.yandexSerpZone.label: Bright Data Yandex SERP Zone
webSearch.yandexSerpZone.help: Optional Bright Data SERP zone override for Yandex searches (fallback env var: BRIGHTDATA_YANDEX_SERP_ZONE).

webSearch.unlockerZone.label: Bright Data Unlocker Zone
webSearch.unlockerZone.help: Bright Data Web Unlocker zone name for scrape tools (default: mcp_unlocker).

webSearch.browserZone.label: Bright Data Browser Zone
webSearch.browserZone.help: Bright Data Browser API zone name for browser tools (default: mcp_browser, ignored when BROWSER_AUTH is set).

webSearch.timeoutSeconds.label: Bright Data Timeout (sec)
webSearch.timeoutSeconds.help: Default timeout in seconds for Bright Data search, scrape, and browser credential requests.

webSearch.pollingTimeoutSeconds.label: Bright Data Polling Timeout (sec)
webSearch.pollingTimeoutSeconds.help: Default polling timeout in seconds for dataset-backed Bright Data tools.
